name: Velyograd HS-12
source:
Story about getting lost without ever moving. A high school where hallways whisper, windows change their views, and memories don’t always agree with each other.

[From [url=https://umigamestudios.itch.io/velyograd-hs-12]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于迷路却一动不动的故事。在一所高中，走廊里窃窃私语，窗户改变了视野，记忆并不总是一致。

[来自[url=https://umigamestudios.itch.io/velyograd-hs-12]Itch.io[/url]]
